description: This file serves as a client-side entry point for a Qwik application, specifically designed for development with no server-side rendering (SSR). It imports the Qwik render function, a Root component, and exports a default function that initiates rendering into the document object with given options.

methods.name: default function
methods.description: An anonymous function exported as default that calls Qwik's render method to mount the Root component into the document with specified options.
